title: Concept: Cassandra error detail disclosed in a response
description: A Cassandra query or host-availability error in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The message names the keyspace, table or ring host, which discloses both the data model and the cluster layout.
applicability: Deployments that render a Cassandra query or host-availability error into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The message names the keyspace, table or ring host, which discloses both the data model and the cluster layout.
